title: IP, IPv6: Add preferences to disable conversation ID assignment
description:
The new feature to add conversation ID numbers to IP and IPv6
conversations increases CPU and memory resource use, in a way
that can be potentially significant for very large files with
lots of conversations. Add preferences to disable them.

Ping #17776, #20131
